english.title: Arrange / facilitate the prostitution / involvement in pornography of a child under 13 years of age
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) intentionally arranged or facilitated the

(A)_[prostitution]_
(B)_[involvement in pornography]_

of a child under the age of 13, namely **(..SPECIFY VICTIM'S AGE..), in any part of the world
english.legislation: Contrary to section 50(1)(a), (b)(ii) and (2) of the Sexual Offences Act 2003
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
intentionally arranged / facilitated
the prostitution / involvement in pornography
of a child under 13
in any part of the world

investigatoraction.description: Criminal lifestyle offence under Schedule 2 to POCA - consider confiscation order

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
An act done by a person in a country or territory outside the United Kingdom which, constituted an offence under the law in force in that country or territory, and would constitute a sexual offence to which this section applies if it had been done in England and Wales or in Northern Ireland, constitutes that sexual offence under the law of that part of the United Kingdom, and provided that person was on 01/09/1997, or who has since become a British citizen or resident in the United Kingdom he/she may have proceedings brought against them in the United Kingdom. (section 72).

This offence document is OBSOLETE from 3rd May 2015 - for offences committed on or after this date CJS code SX03227 (H12216) should be used.

other.penalty:
Summary: Six months imprisonment and / or a fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
Indictment: Fourteen years imprisonment

Time limit for prosecutions:
None

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
